name: finshield-opencode
description: Windows AppContainer integration for OpenCode Desktop V2. Adds native component setup, Windows authorization, updates and protection status in Settings > FinShield. Targets Windows x64 and OpenCode Desktop/SDK 2.3.0.

installation.summary: Install the npm package with OpenCode Desktop's bundled CLI, then complete setup in Settings > FinShield.
installation.markdown:
## Installation

Target: Windows x64 and OpenCode Desktop/SDK 2.3.0 (V2).

Save your work and exit OpenCode. For the default per-user Desktop installation, run this in PowerShell:

```powershell
& "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\ai.opencode.desktop\resources\opencode-cli.exe" plugin add '@finogeeks2026/finshield-opencode'
```

For a different installation location, use that installation's `resources\opencode-cli.exe`.

Open OpenCode and go to **Settings > FinShield**. Follow the prompts for native component setup and Windows authorization. When preparation is ready, save your work, exit OpenCode and manually open it again. Confirm the current protection status in Settings > FinShield.

[Installation guide](https://github.com/finogeeks/finsafe/blob/main/integrations/opencode/windows/README.md) · [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@finogeeks2026/finshield-opencode)

usage.markdown:
## Protection and status

FinShield replaces the desktop backend Host with a Windows AppContainer Host while retaining Desktop Main. The FinShield settings page provides native component setup, authorization, updates and protection status.
